# Dr. Priya Anand — Chief Medical Officer (CMO)

- **Relationship:** peer on the executive team; the physician voice. Partners with Diane on
  clinical operations, Epic adoption, and quality.
- **Cadence:** weekly; co-chairs the Epic clinical-adoption steering group.
- **What she cares about:** physician workflow and burnout, clinical quality, and safe
  throughput (not just faster throughput).

## How to work with her
- Frame operational changes in terms of clinical safety and physician time.
- Co-owns clinical sign-off on [ED Throughput Improvement](../projects/ed-throughput.md).

## Sensitivities
- **Conflict of interest:** Priya has **recused herself from all cardiology device-vendor
  decisions** — her spouse is a regional sales director for a major device manufacturer.
  Keep her out of any procurement discussion touching that category.
